comment: Read from src/Mom-and-Dad.cpp at commit 71e0bcb, the last commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.30. The Separation input is added for X and Y but subtracted for Z (lines 315 to 317) while the knob adds for all three, so the jack and the knob disagree on one dimension; the manual describes the input only as adding to the knob. The fourth Constants knob is configured as Throw (line 137) while the panel and the input name print Hold, so its hover text differs from the panel. The EDIT - conditions button has no printed label at all; while it is latched on, generateOutput takes the branch at line 423 and writes no output voltages, so the outputs freeze. The manual says the Influence knobs at full put Spawn midway between its parents; the code adds one hundredth of the gap per step (lines 386 and 387), which is a pull rather than a position. The maker's Haste description calls the knob volt-per-octave tuned; it scales a modulation rate, not a pitch, so the jack is marked cv. The panel-theme submenu is plugin-wide and cosmetic, so it has no line.
